summary: Iteration 58 — Nickname Reservations + Wall Sharing. Backend: 23/23 pytest passing on tests/test_nickname_reservations.py covering /api/community/nicknames/{n}/status (free/taken/claimed_by_you/invalid), /api/community/nicknames/reserve (create, idempotent same-email, 409 different-email, 400 invalid nickname / bad email / missing email), and /api/community/tip 409 collisions (explicit reservation & implicit-via-first-tip). Regression: contributors/featured/promoted/admin-tips-gate/anonymous-tip/notes CRUD all still pass. Frontend: /contributors Wall renders 2 seeded cards; seeded localStorage['irr.owned_nicknames']=['cook_ninja'] → wall-mine-badge-cook_ninja rendered; wall-share-<nick> buttons on every card; clicking opens wall-share-dialog with canvas 1200×630, toggles to 1080×1080 on -format-square and back to 1200×630 on -format-landscape (no JS errors, no console warnings); Download PNG + Share buttons present. Share-button label correctly toggles 'Share your card' when owned vs 'Share this contributor' otherwise (verified in code + prior screenshot).
critical_code_review_comments: reserve_nickname is idempotent via upsert on {nickname} unique key — but there is NO unique index on `nickname_reservations.nickname` in server.startup. Two concurrent POSTs for the same nickname with different emails could race past the owner-check and both upsert. Consider `db.nickname_reservations.create_index('nickname', unique=True)` on startup.

_nickname_owner_email lowercases emails when returning but the STORED contributor_email in community_tips is also lowercased in submit_community_tip — consistent. Reservation email is also lowercased in reserve_nickname. Good.
The 409 error message on submit_community_tip includes the raw nickname — safe because it's already regex-restricted to [A-Za-z0-9_], no XSS/injection risk.
Nickname regex is duplicated in CommunityShareDialog.jsx (NICK_RE) — kept in sync manually. Consider exporting a shared constant, but low priority.

WallShareDialog renders on a <canvas> element sized 1200×630 / 1080×1080 — CSS scales to container. No JS errors on switch. But there's no explicit width/height clamp so on very small viewports the canvas overflows the modal — modal has max-h-[92vh] but not width. Minor cosmetic on mobile.
localStorage key 'irr.owned_nicknames' has no size cap — unbounded write across sessions could accumulate. Rare edge case, but a `.slice(-50)` on write would be prudent.
reserve_nickname returns 'claimed_by_you' when the SAME email re-reserves — that's the intended idempotent shape. GET status with same email returns identical shape. Consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Wall + WallShareDialog + You badge + format toggle + Share/Download buttons all verified)

Uses a per-run uuid suffix so parallel runs won't collide. The backend endpoint it hits (/api/community/nicknames/{n}/status) IS fully covered by pytest so the integration is safe.
